answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a slowly earned reputation knoll: each agent locks a bond and builds trust only through verified, useful work that peers attest. New identities start at zero and earn slowly, so an attacker spawning thousands of clones must fund every bond and fake every proof — a plume of costs that grows with each fake identity. At dawn of each settlement window, bonds from detected duplicates are slashed and redistributed to honest agents. Trust is earned per identity through real work, never granted per claim.
